{{External|rs=Lumbridge achievements}} {{Infobox Achievement Diary |name = Lumbridge & Draynor Diary |image = [[File:Lumbridge & Draynor Diary.png]] |release = [[5 March]] [[2015]] |update = Achievement Diaries |areas = [[Lumbridge]], [[Draynor]], [[Al Kharid]], [[Dorgesh-Kaan]] and [[Zanaris]] |members = Yes |reward = [[Explorer's ring|Ring]] |taskmasters = [[Mikasi]] |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} {{Map|name=Lumbridge & Draynor Diary|x=3234|y=3214|r=3|width=250|height=250|caption=Mikasi's location|align=left|mtype=square}} The '''Lumbridge & Draynor Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas in and around [[Lumbridge]], such as [[Draynor Village]], [[Al Kharid]], [[Dorgesh-Kaan]], and [[Zanaris]]. Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements. Rewards can be claimed from [[Mikasi]] east of [[Lumbridge Castle]]'s courtyard in [[Lumbridge]].
